messages.subject: mediation analysis with categorical variables
parts: Hi group, I am new to lavaan and running a mediation analysis. All my variables are categorical and binary. the model fit is not good, but some become become when i reduce the number of my endogenous variables. someone told me that i should not worry about the model fit since am using categorical variables. Need help on want to do. thanks in anticipation

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: mediation analysis with categorical variables
parts: All my variables are categorical and binary
Are they multiple indicators of common factors, or are you simply running a path analysis?
the model fit is not good, but some become become when i reduce the number of my endogenous variables

If this is a path analysis, should your model be saturated? Check whether you are allowing (or should allow) the residuals of endogenous variables to correlate.  Sharing your syntax when you post a question is always advisable because it provides more information.
